---
title: "Forest"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(plotly)

forest <- data.frame(
  PlotID = paste0("P", 1:10),
  CanopyCover = c(35,42,51,58,60,67,72,80,85,91),
  SpeciesRichness = c(12,15,18,22,25,30,34,37,40,44)
)

plot_ly(
  forest,
  x = ~CanopyCover,
  y = ~SpeciesRichness,
  text = ~PlotID,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers"
)
```
